rec.name: CRO | Content Section (Quote/Testimonial Slider with Image)

what.text: A custom Shopify section named 'CRO | Content Section'. It is a two-column split layout. One side has a text panel with a small subheading (e.g. an award or press name), a large heading that holds the quote or key message, and a small footer line for the source or product name. The other side has a large rounded image. The editor can add several slides (blocks), each with its own text and image. The text and image sliders are synced and navigated with arrows or pagination, so one quote always pairs with one image. On mobile the layout stacks, with the image on top or bottom.

why.text: Press quotes, awards and customer testimonials shown next to lifestyle or product imagery add third-party credibility at the moment the shopper is judging quality. The paired image shows the product in context, so the proof feels concrete and tied to a specific product. A slider carries several proof points in one compact block without long scrolling. The airy editorial layout also adds a premium brand feel (the reference is burrow.com).

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-content-section.liquid and paste in the supplied code (style, markup, script and schema). Add the section to the Home template (or any page) in the theme editor. Add one 'Item' block per slide. In each block, fill in the subheading, the heading/quote, the footer/source text and the image. Then set the section options: text and background colour, content max-width, alignment, media position, media control, thumbnail corner radius, custom font and spacing. The markup uses two Swiper instances (a left text slider with a fade effect, and a right image slider) that are synced via the controller. The code depends on the Swiper library already being loaded in the theme. Re-initialise on shopify:section:load so the section also works in the editor's design mode.

items: Text colour (falls back to theme colour when transparent)
Italic text colour (used to highlight <em> words in the heading)
Mobile: media control arrows / pagination / none
Per-block: subheading, heading, footer text, image
Per-block: font sizes (desktop and mobile) for subheading, heading and footer
Per-block: heading line height, letter spacing, top/bottom margins, uppercase toggles for subheading, heading and footer

dependencies.text: Swiper JS library must be loaded in the theme (the code uses `new Swiper` with fade, navigation, pagination and controller sync). Requires the Shopify Online Store 2.0 section/blocks architecture and theme settings for fallback heading, text and background colours. The theme should provide a '.container' wrapper class. There are no metafields or apps. Note: the ticket's acceptance criteria call for options such as opacity, image shadow/frame, padding/margin, autoplay and in-editor image size. These are not clearly visible in the supplied code, which is partly truncated, so they may be only partly implemented.

items: Homepage scroll depth / section visibility rate
Click-through rate from the homepage to PDP/collection pages after the section
Bounce rate and engagement time on the homepage
Add-to-cart rate / conversion rate of sessions that viewed the section

images.caption: Reference design (burrow.com): left text panel with small uppercase subheading (GQ Home Awards), large quote heading, small uppercase source line (Range Seating) and prev/next arrows; large lifestyle image on the right, on a warm beige background.

Built section in the Shopify theme editor: left quote text with product-name footer and arrows, right image with rounded corners on a beige background. The settings panel lists text colour, background, content max-width, alignment, custom font, thumbnail radius and section spacing. The three slide blocks are shown in the tree.
